title: DisMech assay and NAM inventory: issues and PRs by gingin77
scope: Issues and PRs authored, assigned or commented on by gingin77 whose focus is a method, assay, model system, NAM, or a framework for recording how a mechanism is measured. Disease curation work is excluded. Record links point at the live DisMech site; issue and PR metadata was read from GitHub on the generation date. The AOP framework groups are listed in aop-framework-inventory-2026-10-13.md; each group's document field says which file it appears in.

4873.title: curate NAMs from NAMsters symposium
4873.author: mellybelly
4873.why: Enrich existing entries with NAM evidence from presenters at the Triangle CERSI NAMeRS 2026 summit (organoids, organ-chips, iPSC, zebrafish, in silico).
4873.achieved: Agent-authored child PRs (#4874, #4892, #4910, #4940, #4972, #5004, #5336, #5477, #7123, #8886) added the platforms listed under methods to nine entries and modules, mostly as evidence items and later as structured experimental_models.
4873.blockers: Two Griffith PMIDs in the auto-summary were hallucinated and several agent-recalled PMIDs resolved to the wrong paper. The EAC chip modelled a docetaxel triplet, not the CROSS regimen. just validate-references reported zero checks on modules. The scanner re-audited the whole epic until gingin77 split out #9792, #9793 and #9794. Virtual imaging trials, tonsil explants and tumour-on-chip immunotherapy were never curated.
methods: zebrafish novel-tank, dark-flash thigmotaxis and edge-preference anxiety assays
iPSC sensory-neuron microphysiological system with deep-learning readout
Liver-Chip, iPSC liver organoids, HLA-genotyped organoid plus CD8 T-cell co-culture

9792.title: Link the NSCLC lung organ-chip into the pathograph as a structured experimental_models entry
9792.author: gingin77
9792.why: The lung organ-chip paper was cited only as an evidence item on the Targeted Therapy treatment; with no experimental_models record the model was invisible to the mechanism graph.
9792.achieved: PR #9665 (mellybelly) added the ORGAN_ON_CHIP record with links to Oncogenic Driver Mutations, Tumor Microenvironment Remodeling and Metastasis; #9931 then grounded the TKI readout in GO and closed this issue.
9792.blockers: Paper cache is abstract-only (publisher returns 403), so quotable text was nearly exhausted. gingin77 objected that the Tumor Microenvironment link overclaims because the chip has no immune or stromal cells, and that cell_types and cell_source are not in the cached abstract. The dormancy/persister finding has no home node. The structured fidelity, limitations and readouts layer of ModelMechanismLink is essentially unused for NAMs.
methods: human orthotopic NSCLC lung organ-chip (Hassell 2017, PMID:29020635)

9793.title: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma has no NAM (organoid/organ-chip) evidence
9793.author: gingin77
9793.why: ESCC had no organoid, chip or iPSC evidence; its only in vitro item was a conventional SOX2 cell-line study while the adenocarcinoma sibling got a tumour-chip citation.
9793.blockers: No ESCC organ-chip literature exists, so the entry got an organoid NAM instead. A batched Europe PMC query returned the wrong abstract under one PMID, so each PMID had to be fetched individually. Two candidates were rejected: murine organoids with an allograft readout, and an editorial.

9794.title: Scope decision: where does purely computational NAM evidence (virtual imaging trials) belong?
9794.author: gingin77
9794.why: The in-silico strand of NAMeRS was never curated and no cardiovascular entry is an obvious home; it needs a maintainer decision, not a curation run.
9794.achieved: Nothing added; no maintainer decision recorded.
9794.blockers: The bot argued the design decisions already exclude acquisition parameters, per-patient reads and radiology decision support, which a virtual imaging trial simulates, and that Sauer 2024 makes no claim about how atherosclerosis works. Proposed criterion: judge by what the paper claims, not the method. COMPUTATIONAL evidence is thin (642 items vs 9,065 IN_VITRO).
methods: virtual imaging trials (Duke Center for Virtual Imaging Trials)

10432.title: Seven NAM experimental models in Stargardt, Noonan, and Ulcerative Colitis never reach the pathograph
10432.author: gingin77
10432.why: Thirteen non-animal models were curated for the NAMO rare-disease bridge, but the seven in Stargardt, Noonan and Ulcerative Colitis had no modeled_mechanisms and sat as disconnected list entries.
10432.achieved: Fixed by agent PR #10573, which wired each model to pathograph nodes with typed relationships.
10432.blockers: The issue's candidate targets were wrong in three places (the retinal organoid paper supports no RPE, lipofuscin or A2E link). A RAF1 S257L paper contradicts the ERK to hypertrophy edge and was recorded as REFUTE with HUMAN_MODEL_MISMATCH. The healthy-tissue colon-on-chip was capped at MEASURES/LOW. No coverage metric exists for model-to-mechanism wiring. CF and Crohn's links still lack relationship, fidelity and limitations.

802.title: Track missing high-value NAM target diseases for future dismech entries
802.author: cmungall
802.why: Parking lot for diseases absent from dismech with strong organoid/MPS literature, so models can be linked to pathograph nodes rather than free text.
802.achieved: gingin77's 2026-09-23 status: all seven diseases now have entries; reframed as a NAM-linkage checklist. After #12582 only Usher remains open. IPF was already done (lung-on-chip and AT2/fibroblast organoid, conforming to fibrotic_response).
802.blockers: Usher waits on node structure from #10822. No parent-level CRC, RP or LCA entries by the granularity decision. Auto-summary MONDO IDs were wrong and corrected. No RPE65/LCA2 entry yet.
methods: organoid and MPS literature for CRC, TSC, RP, IPF, LCA, Usher and Wilson disease

10822.title: Lump/split: Usher syndrome models one protein complex that does not exist — split into four mechanism entities plus a grouping
10822.author: cmungall
10822.why: Usher syndrome node structure that the NAM-linkage checklist in #802 depends on.
10822.achieved: Not part of this inventory; referenced as the blocker for the Usher row.

9997.title: Add experimental models to the fibrotic_response module
9997.author: gingin77
9997.why: fibrotic_response is the most-reused module in the KB and carried no experimental models, a gap made visible by two newly curated organ-specific fibrosis NAMs that both land on its nodes.
9997.achieved: Asked for an experimental_models block on the module linked to Mesenchymal Cell Activation and Excessive ECM Deposition; delivered by #10282.
9997.blockers: The two NAMs in hand are explicitly organ-specific and neither is a fair stand-in for fibrosis generally; the entire chip and organoid fibrosis literature is organ-partitioned. Precision-cut slices were rejected as murine with no NAMO class for ex vivo slices. Module model blocks all carry tissue_term and an organ-agnostic model has nothing to put there.

10051.title: Liver fibrosis NAM as a test case for the AOP Assay/NAM bridge
10051.author: gingin77
10051.why: The alignment page listed Assay/NAM to ExperimentalModel as the cheapest existing bridge to AOP-Wiki and nothing had exercised it; the #9935 liver NAM is a case that can, approached assay-first rather than stressor-first.
10051.achieved: A mapping proposal: KE 55 to Hepatocyte Injury and Death, KE 1492/1493 to Kupffer Cell and Inflammatory Response, KE 265 to Hepatic Stellate Cell Activation, KE 68 to Excessive ECM Deposition; MIE KE 244 unmapped. Closed by #10257.
10051.blockers: Nothing in the schema refers to an AOP, KER or KE and AOP-Wiki is not citable as evidence. AOP ontology terms are leads, not bindings. Acetaminophen to KE 244 unresolved on a subscription-only paper. Both endpoints fall outside the node layer. The bot argued the mapping belongs at the module layer.
methods: AOP 38 (protein alkylation leading to liver fibrosis) mapped onto the Akura Twin MPS

8309.title: Explore how dismech's environmental-exposure modeling relates to the Adverse Outcome Pathway (AOP) framework
8309.author: gingin77
8309.why: Map where dismech's exposure to mechanism to outcome layer aligns with MIE, KE, KER and AO and decide what, if anything, to adopt; pilot AOP 17 vs Lead_Poisoning.
8309.achieved: Produced the AOP_EMOD_ALIGNMENT project page (#10002), the lead use case against eight lead AOPs, the AOP 38 worked example (#10257, #10299), three causal edges in Lead_Poisoning (#8392), and eight biological_scale tags.
8309.blockers: Pilot premise was wrong (no mitochondria to oxidative stress edge; zero nodes with biological_scale). A weight-of-evidence grade is not evidence. The MIE/KE/AO role tag was deferred with no issue; two questions documented without a verdict.
methods: EMOD Assay, Observation and KER Evidence classes as the measurement side of the comparison

10344.title: AOP/EMOD project page: record why the pilot comparator changed and clear the stale TODO
10344.author: gingin77
10344.why: The page mapped eight lead AOPs instead of #8309's AOP 17 with the reason hidden in a non-rendering HTML comment, and carried a stale TODO.
10344.achieved: Three prose edits delivered by #10760, including the ADME correction: lead absorption and distribution are toxicokinetic and ALAD inhibition is the MIE-shaped node.
10344.blockers: All ten environmental entries TRIGGERS into a toxicokinetic node, so the assumed MIE correspondence is wrong in a specific direction; none of the 35 tabulated KEs is a heme or ALAD event.

10687.title: Record in AOP_EMOD_ALIGNMENT that an AOP is not a mechanism boundary
10687.author: gingin77
10687.why: A KER lookup on five androgen-receptor-axis KEs returned 28 KERs in two biological groups, but grouping by parent AOP scattered the 24-edge androgen group across 19 AOPs with KER 2124 in ten.
10687.achieved: Partially delivered by #10760 (divergence row, three rules, Villeneuve 2014 citation); the same guidance sits in mie-ker-capture step 6.
10687.blockers: Measurements, hub-KE caveat, Knapen 2018 and the networkFinder pointer were withdrawn pending a 3-vs-2 component discrepancy; the OpenScientist report still asserts three components.

10772.title: AOP_EMOD_ALIGNMENT: dismech evidence cannot record how a causal claim was measured
10772.author: gingin77
10772.why: EvidenceItem can say the study category but not the experimental system or method; EMOD structures this explicitly.
10772.achieved: Comparison written to the page by #11394.
10772.blockers: assays already exists on Pathophysiology and Biochemical but is unused: curators were told not to use it and OBI has no OAK adapter or enum cache; ECO is absent entirely. No schema change proposed; workaround is a 'Measured by <method> in <system>' prefix in explanation.
methods: whole-cell voltage clamp in isolated rabbit sino-atrial node myocytes

10272.title: Work the six open AOP schema questions in the AOP/EMOD alignment project
10272.author: gingin77
10272.why: Alignment surfaced six things the schema cannot express: KE cross-reference on a node, where an AO correspondence attaches, declaring aop prefixes, a population level in BiologicalScaleEnum, species applicability on a mechanism, marking a node toxicokinetic.
10272.achieved: Nothing merged; gingin77 noted it was created from a misunderstanding but kept it open for discussion. No schema change should be made on this issue alone.
10272.blockers: Prefix question near-settled by namo:/clinvar: precedent; Q4 should be a recorded no (7,731 scale tags, none population-level); Q5 blocked because AnimalModel.species is free text; Q6 belongs to the aggregate exposure pathway framework; Q2 blocked on Liver_Cirrhosis having no fibrosis node (#10310).

10454.title: New project: AOP-derived_causal_evidence_use_cases
10454.author: gingin77
10454.why: KER3445 (PDE inhibition to increased cAMP, AOP 558) checked against primary literature is false in the healthy heart and true only per isoform, compartment or disease state; such verifications need a home.
10454.achieved: Nothing merged; proposed projects/AOP_DERIVED_CAUSAL_EVIDENCE_USE_CASES.md. gingin77 added that completion_score 29.41 identifies 1,536 of 2,369 stub KERs and that none of AOP 558's ten citations measures cAMP after PDE inhibition.
10454.blockers: AOP-Wiki grades KER3445 High with every evidence section empty; KE693 is tagged Tissue while evidence is subcellular and dismech biological_scale has nothing subcellular either; readout choice (cAMP vs ICa,L) flips disease dependence; a cited cache file is not in the repo.
methods: FRET cAMP biosensors (Epac2-camps cytosolic, Epac2-alphaKAP SERCA2-targeted)

10773.title: Keep an inventory of AOP-Wiki data errors found during curation
10773.author: gingin77
10773.why: AOP 552 cited a DOI resolving to a different paper and one that does not resolve; AOP 558's bibliography does not evidence its named step. Nowhere to record such errors.
10773.achieved: Nothing merged; a register at projects/AOP_EMOD_ALIGNMENT/aop-wiki-data-errors.md was requested.
10773.blockers: Bot sweep: 13 of 16 AOP 552 references defective (8 off-topic, 5 unresolvable); AOPs 552, 558 and 560 share one submitter group with empty OECD tables. Upstream reporting left undecided; mechanical DOI sweep deferred.

10456.title: AOP-derived content review: add the aop-wiki and mie-ker-capture skills
10456.author: gingin77
10456.why: Two locally working skills for turning AOP-Wiki KEs into verified dismech edges needed committing, blocked until aop_wiki_cli was installable.
10456.blockers: Blocked on aop_wiki_cli#6 (68-file refactor). KER count discrepancy (2,369 vs 2,361). 29.41 percent is a CLI artefact, so the check is stated as no references, no empirical-support text and no plausibility text. search-with-config only loads packaged configs. AOP-Wiki not citable; a structured source would not make a KER evidence for a mechanism.

10949.title: A causal edge cannot carry a confidence, so the claim most in need of one is the claim that cannot express it
10949.author: aleixpuigb
10949.why: mechanism_confidence exists on Pathophysiology only; a CausalEdge cannot say an arrow is a hypothesis.
10949.achieved: Nothing merged. gingin77's 2026-09-16 comment: 37,247 downstream edges, 43 percent cited; 8,390 uncited DIRECT edges vs 3,067 declared hedges; AOP-Wiki grades the claim while dismech grades the citation, so the confidence slot should be settled before the #7855 connectivity check.
10949.blockers: Maintainer decision needed jointly with the causal_effect polarity question before changing the edge shape.

12682.title: Add ToxCast as a structured reference source
12682.author: gingin77
12682.why: A chemical to assay hit-call is a citable fact nothing in the repository can verify; a fabricated activity claim would pass every gate.
12682.achieved: Nothing merged. Specification for a TOXCAST: prefix and per-chemical cache files; reframed as a project issue with the metadata half split to #12858. Hit-call work survives only on an archived local branch.
12682.blockers: EPA host fails DNS from sandboxed and CI environments; API key must be requested by email; the sizing paper is paywalled with no PMC deposit; an API-backed source does not fit the sha256 manifest pattern; the assays slot and AssayTerm enum are unvalidatable because OBI is absent from oak_config.
methods: ToxCast/Tox21 chemical hit-calls as a StructuredSource keyed on DTXSID
Jeong and Choi 2020 plastic-additive screen as sizing target

12858.title: Map ToxCast assays to DisMech pathograph nodes using assay metadata
12858.author: gingin77
12858.why: ToxCast assays are molecular-level NAMs; their metadata could map an assay to a pathograph node independently of any chemical result. Measure how far that reaches and whether dismech can represent such a mapping.
12858.achieved: Deliverables 1 and 2 landed via #13226 and #13228 (coverage page and THRB worked example); 3 to 5 remain open. 1,570 endpoints, 1,108 with a gene symbol, 497 targets, 1,324 human.
12858.blockers: experimental_models is a slot on Disease and links must target a node in the same file, so a disease-agnostic endpoint is copied everywhere with no shared identity. Gene-symbol joins fail by lesion vs state, direction reversal and quantity substitution. No model type for 456 biochemical and 25 cell-free endpoints. 461 endpoints declare no gene. The EPA API has no version endpoint.
methods: EPA CTX assay-endpoint metadata (gene target, target family, biological process, organism, tissue, assay function, signal direction)
CTX bioactivity/aop endpoint for AOP-Wiki Key Event links

13224.title: ToxCast biologicalProcessTarget terms that resolve to GO, and which of them can reach a pathograph node
13224.author: gingin77
13224.why: biologicalProcessTarget looked like the cheapest bridge from an assay to a node: 38 distinct values, and dismech binds biological_processes to GO.
13224.achieved: No PR. A nine-row lookup of the GO-resolving values covering 507 of 1,522 annotated endpoints; H295R identified as the one substantive new bridge to steroid-synthesis nodes.
13224.blockers: The top two terms carry 392 of 507 and are too broad to license an edge; honest opportunity is about 115 endpoints. 29 values do not resolve; three carry EPA typos. H295R endpoints list the hormone's receptor as gene target rather than a biosynthetic enzyme. cmungall: GO is only for programmed processes, so toxic cell death must not bind GO cell death.
methods: ToxCast biologicalProcessTarget vocabulary resolved to GO
H295R steroidogenesis assay (OECD TG 456, CEETOX and CCTE HTRF endpoints)

13225.title: GO:0051882 mitochondrial depolarization is a narrow, usable ToxCast-to-pathograph bridge
13225.author: gingin77
13225.why: GO:0051882 mitochondrial depolarization is the narrowest usable bridge in the biologicalProcessTarget vocabulary, already bound by two dismech nodes.
13225.achieved: No PR; a scoping analysis. Six endpoints are four measurements; none declares a gene target, so the bridge is invisible to the gene-symbol join, which is what makes it worth having.
13225.blockers: fitc and rhodamine are background channels behind the ratio. The HepG2 time series has no place on a readout. Unresolved evidence policy: does an assay measuring a process justify evidence on a node asserting it, or only where a chemical is the recorded cause. Endpoint identity has nowhere to live; no ToxCast endpoint name appears in kb/.

13161.title: Add an Endocrine Disruptor Screening History section to the Estrogen Signalling project page
13161.author: gingin77
13161.why: The estrogen project page claimed ESR1 is among the most heavily assayed ToxCast targets and the receptor the US statute was written around, and cited nothing.
methods: ToxCast ER and AR pathway models

13450.title: Add the zebrafish VAMR behaviour assay (Spath et al. 2026) to the KB, starting with chlorpyrifos in Organophosphate_Poisoning
13450.author: gingin77
13450.why: The paper tests the VAMR assay on 17 DNT reference chemicals and dismech has no record of the assay; add it one chemical at a time, starting with chlorpyrifos.
13450.achieved: Step 1 delivered by #13451 and #13452. Later steps: trichlorfon, ketamine (nmda_receptor_hypofunction), nicotine.
13450.blockers: Paper not in PMC; quotable text only via the Zenodo copy; the printed dataset DOI does not resolve. Behaviour only, no AChE measured. Acute and developmental arms move in opposite directions; supplementary tables carry no direction. Text and supplement disagree twice. No node is named for habituation. Core design question: how to represent one assay once so each chemical's result points back to it.
methods: zebrafish larval Visual and Acoustic Motor Response (VAMR) behaviour assay (Spath et al. 2026, PMID:41780647): acute and developmental arms, 26 endpoints, hit rule >=0.9 with <2 curve-fit flags

13749.title: Major Depressive Disorder: seed animal_models from C. elegans serotonin, insulin/FOXO and antidepressant-pharmacology work
13749.author: gingin77
13749.why: Major_Depressive_Disorder had twelve pathophysiology nodes, nine treatments and two hypotheses but no animal_models section; worm work is unusually well suited to three of its nodes and to its SSRI and lithium treatments, for the upstream half of the entry rather than the adverse outcome.
13749.achieved: Closed by five PRs: #13755 (SSRI mechanism qualified), #13756 (tph-1 and daf-2 models), #13757 (risk-gene panels as a knowledge gap), #13759 (serotonin-to-FOXO arm resolved as HUMAN_MODEL_MISMATCH after an OpenScientist run), #13776 (cross-link and forced-swim citations). Decisions taken: Caenorhabditis elegans as the species string; TPH2 and INSR as human orthologs with alternatives in notes; no insulin/FOXO node.
13749.blockers: The worm cannot have depression and nothing may be recorded as modelling the adverse outcome. Orthology is one-to-many (daf-2 to INSR, IGF1R, INSRR; daf-16 to four FOXO genes). The 2024 and 2026 panels are suicidality genes and contain none of the entry's five genes. Every paper in the program shares one senior author and no divergence type expresses single-group provenance. Tier 3 stress-assay papers and a mouse-only paper were flagged as easy to miscite. Fluoxetine-resistance, ketamine-collagen and mianserin papers had nowhere to land.
methods: tph-1 serotonin-synthesis null C. elegans (Liang 2006, Sze 2000)
risk-gene mutant panels in a foraging assay (Sall 2021, Ajayi 2024, Dustin and Dwyer 2026)
C. elegans fluoxetine, ketamine, lithium and clozapine pharmacology

13754.title: Mood disorders record no models at all: promote the model papers already cited, and scope deep research for four gaps
13754.author: gingin77
13754.why: All four mood-disorder entries lack animal_models, experimental_models and computational_models, while already citing 14 model-organism papers inside mechanism nodes that are invisible as models.
13754.achieved: Nothing merged. The issue separates promotion of already-cited models from four deep-research areas and ranks them; the worm work stayed on #13749. gingin77 noted the schema blocker became #13768 and corrected a bot claim that perturbations exists on ExperimentalModel.
13754.blockers: Most depression models are procedures applied to wild-type animals and AnimalModel has no perturbation slot; the stress-paradigm area cannot be curated well until that is resolved. No consensus bipolar mania model; PMDD may have no animal model at all.
methods: Clock knockdown, GSK-3beta haploinsufficiency and Cacna1c deficiency mice
chronic unpredictable mild stress, chronic social defeat and learned helplessness paradigms

13602.title: NAMs inventory - what fits and what's fringe
13602.author: gingin77
13602.why: No stated rule in dismech for when a NAM belongs in a disease entry; a NAM inventory needs a fits, fringe, does-not-fit sorting.
13602.achieved: Nothing added; discussion only. Counts on main 2026-10-05: 1,251 models in 600 entries; 212 links lack a relationship.
13602.blockers: No structured exposure, dose or duration; no donor-population field; no field for the tie; one model nested in one disease file (the valproate/lithium panel is relevant to four or more entries); CAUSE_UNREPRESENTED was written for computational models. Needs maintainer judgement.
methods: NAM fit/fringe sorting by what ties the model to the disease

13600.title: Bipolar Disorder: add a lithium-exposed human neural progenitor model
13600.author: gingin77
13600.why: Bipolar_Disorder has no experimental_models or animal_models.
13600.blockers: Donors are unaffected, so it models how lithium acts on human progenitors, not the disease. No neurogenesis or progenitor node. The dose-response comes from Wolter 2023, not Valone 2026. Genotype-by-treatment effects have no structured field. Heritability and TWAS enrichments are statistical results, not phenotype evidence. Held pending #13602.
methods: primary human fetal cortical neural progenitors from 83 genotyped unaffected donors exposed to LiCl for 48 h (Wolter 2023, Valone 2026)

13768.title: AnimalModel records species as free text and cannot record a non-genetic perturbation: give it the organism and perturbation shape from #13548
13768.author: gingin77
13768.why: AnimalModel records species as free text (66 strings for 2,381 models) and has no slot for a non-genetic perturbation, so stress, diet, surgery, infection and toxin models bury the procedure in genotype, description or category.
13768.achieved: Nothing merged. Proposes organism with range OrganismDescriptor, a perturbations list adapted from the EvidencePerturbation design on the #13548 backup branch but allowing a perturbation with no gene, and a gate that checks a model's gene namespace against its organism.
13768.blockers: species is an anchor key the entity-ref resolver uses; the 24 unmigrated bound-organism records from #8199 would lose their binding if moved today; #13754 and #13450 are blocked on the slot; the committed datamodel already lags the schema (#13436).
methods: perturbations list with no required gene on AnimalModel and ExperimentalModel

13774.title: Nothing enforces the rule that whole-organism models go in animal_models: 50 experimental models still use the pre-#8199 OTHER workaround
13774.author: gingin77

recurring_blockers.blocker: No disease-agnostic assay record: experimental_models lives on Disease and a link must target a node in the same file, so a reusable endpoint is copied per disease with no shared identity.
The assays slot is bound to OBI with no OAK adapter or enum cache, and ECO is absent, so how a claim was measured cannot be recorded structurally.

Several of the primary papers behind the models curated here (the NSCLC organ-chip, the Akura Twin liver MPS, the ToxCast sizing paper and the zebrafish VAMR assay) were available only as abstracts or behind a paywall. Because dismech evidence must quote the cached reference, the quotable text in those cases ran out before the model's readouts were all covered.

Models involving co-cultures, gravity-linked plates and ex vivo slices, revealed some NAMO vocabulary gaps. Specifically, NAMO has no class for a non-perfused, gravity-linked microphysiological plate (its MPS class is abstract and requires microfluidics) or for ex vivo tissue slices, and the project page's in-scope list showed only four of NAMO's 56 classes, so one model was first left unbound for the wrong reason.
AnimalModel binds no organism and has no perturbation slot, so procedure-based and exposure-based whole-organism models have nowhere structured to say what was done to them.
Worm-to-human and fish-to-human gene orthology is one-to-many, and the human-ortholog convention on model genes forces a pick the biology does not support.
No structured exposure, dose, duration, kinetic series, donor population or gene-by-exposure interaction on a model.
Exposures land on toxicokinetic nodes, never on a molecular initiating event, and nothing marks a node toxicokinetic.
